title: Lantern explain output
description: Resolved Unified Control ID (UCID) entry from the umbrella-govops registry, as produced by `lantern explain -f json`.

id.description: Canonical Unified Control ID, e.g. UCID-DATA-BIAS-001.

title.description: Short human-readable name for the control.

status.description: Lifecycle of the UCID in the upstream registry.

implementing_controls.description: Internal control identifiers in umbrella-govops policy bundles that implement this UCID.

nist_ai_rmf.description: NIST AI Risk Management Framework citations (MAP-x.x, MEASURE-x.x, MANAGE-x.x, GOVERN-x.x).

eu_ai_act_annex_iv.description: EU AI Act Annex IV technical-documentation point references.
